caption:
Growing faster than your cash flow can keep pace with is a genuinely good problem — but it's still a problem worth solving deliberately, rather than letting it strain the business or slow down the growth itself.

Working capital finance, sized to the specific gap, can carry the business through until cash flow catches up to the new pace.
